entities.summary:
Zhang Ji was a military general who played a pivotal role in the late Eastern Han dynasty of China, serving under the warlord Dong Zhuo. His military campaigns were marked by brutal suppression and violence, leaving a lasting legacy of bloodshed and instability in the region.

Zhang Ji's actions had significant consequences for the future of China, contributing to the eventual collapse of the Han dynasty and paving the way for the rise of new powers in the region.

Despite his notorious reputation, Zhang Ji's legacy has been the subject of much debate among historians, with some viewing him as a ruthless warlord and others as a skilled military strategist.
